description: Source code for command-line group management commands in Mattermost, including LDAP group listing, channel and team group enable/disable/status, and user group restore.

methods.name: listLdapGroupsCmdF
methods.description: Lists LDAP groups using the client.

methods.name: channelGroupEnableCmdF
methods.description: Enables group constraints in a specified channel.

methods.name: channelGroupDisableCmdF
methods.description: Disables group constraints in a specified channel.

methods.name: channelGroupStatusCmdF
methods.description: Shows the group constraint status for a channel.

methods.name: channelGroupListCmdF
methods.description: Lists groups associated with a channel.

methods.name: teamGroupEnableCmdF
methods.description: Enables group constraints in a team.

methods.name: teamGroupDisableCmdF
methods.description: Disables group constraints in a team.

methods.name: teamGroupStatusCmdF
methods.description: Shows the group constraint status for a team.

methods.name: teamGroupListCmdF
methods.description: Lists groups associated with a team.
